title: Main Wheel Brake Heat Stack — Replacement
abstract: Replacement of the carbon heat stack in a main wheel brake assembly, covering the wear pin datum record, the tie bolt sequence and the bedding-in run that must be completed before the aircraft returns to service.

sections.purpose: To replace the carbon heat stack in a main wheel brake assembly and to bed the new stack in before the aircraft returns to service.
sections.job_setup_note: The brake must be cool: at least three hours after the last landing, or measured below sixty degrees at the stack. The aircraft must be on jacks with the wheel removed. The wear pin datum must be recorded before the stack is disturbed. Carbon dust is a respiratory hazard and a mask is required when the stack is opened. Two persons are needed and the brake assembly must be handled on the trolley.
sections.procedure: WARNING: DO NOT WORK ON A HOT BRAKE. WAIT AT LEAST THREE HOURS AFTER THE LAST LANDING OR MEASURE THE STACK BELOW SIXTY DEGREES CELSIUS. Put the aircraft on jacks and remove the wheel. Record the wear pin projection against the datum and note the number of landings since the last stack change. Remove the brake assembly onto the trolley. WARNING: WEAR A RESPIRATORY MASK WHEN THE STACK IS OPENED. CARBON DUST IS A RESPIRATORY HAZARD. Remove the tie bolts in the sequence in the task, releasing the stack load evenly. Remove the discs one at a time, keeping them in order, and record the thickness of each. Examine the torque tube and the piston housing for heat distress and for oxidation. Clean the housing and examine the manifold D3240114184230 for leakage at the piston seals. CAUTION: DO NOT MIX DISCS FROM TWO STACKS. THE FRICTION PAIR IS MATCHED AND A MIXED STACK GIVES ASYMMETRIC BRAKING. Build the new stack in the order in the task, checking the orientation mark on each disc. Install the tie bolts and torque them in three passes to the final value, renewing the washers AGS678120-8C. Install the brake assembly and connect the hydraulic line. Bleed the brake and check for leakage at working pressure. Install the wheel and torque the axle nut. Set the new wear pin datum and record it.
sections.close_out: Lower the aircraft and remove the jacks. Do the bedding-in run as described in the task, applying the brake at the specified speeds and letting the stack cool between applications. Check for leakage and for unusual noise after the run. Record the replacement, the disc thicknesses removed, the new wear pin datum, the tie bolt torque values and the bedding-in run result. Report any asymmetry felt during the run before the next flight.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The disc order and the bedding-in schedule differ for the cold weather stack.

safety_precautions: Do not work on a hot brake.
Wear a respiratory mask when the stack is opened.
Do not mix discs from two stacks.
